string.name: cfg_hs_rebuild_failed
string.value: Couldn't rebuild the hotspot with the new settings: %s

string.name: cfg_hs_rebuilt
string.value: Hotspot rebuilt with the new settings. Reconnect the console once.

string.name: cfg_hs_edit_note
string.value: After changing, reconnect the console to the new network. If the hotspot is on, it's rebuilt automatically.

string.name: cfg_hs_auto_title
string.value: Turn on hotspot when the app opens

string.name: cfg_hs_auto_desc
string.value: No need to turn it on manually each time. Won't create a duplicate if it's already running.

string.name: cfg_hs_desc
string.value: Your phone creates a 5 GHz hotspot for the console (channels 36–48, WPA2). No router in between, so the connection is more stable with lower latency.

string.name: cfg_hs_settings_desc
string.value: View name and password, customize, turn on automatically

string.name: cfg_opt_subtitle
string.value: You can also change these while playing via the Settings button (top right), without reconnecting.

string.name: cfg_opt_audio_desc
string.value: In TCP Bridge, turning it off stops audio transmission and saves ~1.5 Mbps; other modes just mute locally.

string.name: cfg_opt_smooth_desc
string.value: Low latency: ≤80ms buffer, for playing; Smoothness: ≤300ms buffer, for watching

string.name: cfg_opt_netopt_desc
string.value: TCP quick ACK + Huawei Network Boost (real-time gaming scene, high-priority connections)

string.name: cfg_opt_screen_off
string.value: Turn off device screen while streaming

string.name: cfg_opt_screen_off_desc
string.value: Saves power and reduces heat; the screen turns back on after disconnecting (SysDVR 6.0+)

string.name: cfg_opt_keep_alive_desc
string.value: Keeps receiving without rendering, shows a Live View in the notification bar, and resumes within a second when you return

string.name: cfg_opt_stats_desc
string.value: Shows frame rate, bitrate, buffering, etc. while playing, for troubleshooting stutter

string.name: hs_err_wlan_off
string.value: Turn on WLAN first (it must be on, but doesn't need to be connected to a network)

string.name: hs_err_system_hotspot
string.value: Turn off the system personal hotspot first; the two conflict

string.name: hs_err_no_channel
string.value: Couldn't create it on a channel the console supports: %s

string.name: hs_err_ssid_long
string.value: Network name too long: max 32 bytes (a Chinese character counts as 3)

string.name: hs_err_pass
string.value: Password must be 8–63 letters, digits or symbols (WPA2 requirement)

string.name: hs_still_running
string.value: The device hotspot is still running (it wasn't turned off last time)

string.name: hs_reclaimed
string.value: The device hotspot was turned off (WLAN was turned off, or the system reclaimed it)

string.name: hs_detail_switch_steps
string.value: On the console: System Settings → Internet → Internet Settings, choose this network and enter the password

string.name: hs_warn_sta
string.value: Your phone is still connected to “%s” (%s, channel %d), which is on a different channel from the device hotspot (channel %d). The Wi-Fi chip has to hop between them, causing dropped frames and audio. Disconnect it in WLAN settings (keep WLAN itself on; turning WLAN off also turns off the hotspot).

string.name: hs_auto_failed
string.value: Couldn't turn on the device hotspot automatically: %s

string.name: cfg_hs_unsaved
string.value: Changes not saved yet. Tap Save at the top right to apply them.

string.name: cfg_opt_freeze_desc
string.value: When network hiccups cause dropped frames, hold the last intact frame until the next keyframe instead of showing corrupted video

string.name: cfg_opt_enhance_desc
string.value: Uses the system's video detail enhancement to upscale 720p to your screen resolution for a sharper picture on large screens. Standard is fast; High looks better but takes longer. Falls back to direct output if unsupported
